description: This Java class 'MemoryMonitoring' tracks JVM memory usage, logs metrics, and optionally writes memory statistics to a CSV file. It implements listeners for server logs and request matchers to update memory data.

classes.name: MemoryMonitoring
classes.description: A class that monitors JVM memory usage, logs metrics, and writes statistics to CSV, implementing log and matcher listener interfaces.

methods.name: MemoryMonitoring
methods.description: Constructor initializing memory monitoring, setting up CSV file logging and registering listeners.

methods.name: getJVMMemory
methods.description: Static method returning a summary of JVM memory for specified MemoryType (HEAP or NON_HEAP).

methods.name: logMemoryMetrics
methods.description: Logs current memory metrics to CSV if enabled.

methods.name: writeLineToCsv
methods.description: Writes a line of text to the CSV file.

methods.name: buildStatistics
methods.description: Builds and returns a list of JVM memory statistics and server state info.

methods.name: updated (MockServerEventLog)
methods.description: Updates log entries count and logs memory metrics if appropriate.

methods.name: updated (RequestMatchers, MockServerMatcherNotifier.Cause)
methods.description: Updates expectations count and logs memory metrics if appropriate.

methods.name: shouldLogMetrics
methods.description: Determines if memory metrics should be logged based on update frequency.
